test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Harihara and Bukka established an independent state in Karnataka and established the capital city Vijayanagar on the banks of river _____________ in 1336.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tungabhadra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Two brothers** named **Harihara and Bukka** founded the **Vijayanagar state in 1336.**
 
• They were soldiers in **Muhammad-bin-Tughlaq's army**
 
• In **1336, **they seceded from the **Delhi Sultanate **and founded an **independent state in Karnataka.**
 
• They established** Vijayanagar as its capital** city on the banks of the **Tungabhadra River.**
 
• The majority of the Tungabhadra River's journey in India begins and **ends in the state of Karnataka. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Betwa:** 

 
 
• A tributary of the Yamuna, the Betwa is a river in **Central and Northern India.**
 
• It begins just north of **Narmadapuram in the Vindhya Range **and flows northeast through **Orchha and Madhya Pradesh** to reach Uttar Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Mahanadi:**
 
 
• In **East Central India,** the Mahanadi River is a significant river.
 
• **Hirakud Dam** is another notable feature of** Mahanadi.**
 
• Prior to entering the **Bay of Bengal, the river passes **through the states of** Chhattisgarh and Odisha.**
 
 
 
• **Tapi:**
 
 
• The Tapti River is a river in central India that travels west before **emptying into the Arabian Sea.**
 
• It is situated** south of the Narmada River.**
